parties.petitioner: R. S. Madireddy and Anr. etc.

summary: Maintainability of writ petitions post-privatisation; crystallised right to relief upon institution; no divestment of substantive rights by subsequent events; reliance on Pasupuleti Venkateswarlu, Rajesh D. Darbar; distinction between equity and jurisdiction; High Court error in dismissing writs on non-maintainability after Air India privatisation; writ jurisdiction sustains despite privatisation during pendency.
legal_provisions_cited: Constitution of India, 1950 Art.12, Art.14, Art.16, Art.21, Art.226
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; writ petitions remanded for consideration on merits.
